# Stripe integration best practices (Stripe)

Stripe's own guidance on choosing the right APIs and building secure payment integrations.

- Source: https://github.com/stripe/ai
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/ai/main/skills/stripe-best-practices/SKILL.md
- Author: Stripe
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/stripe-integration-best-practices-stripe-517f1da0

Helps Claude make sound Stripe decisions: Checkout Sessions versus PaymentIntents, Connect platform setup, subscriptions, Stripe Tax, sandboxes for testing, and moving off deprecated APIs. It includes security rules for API keys, restricted keys, webhooks and OAuth. It routes to reference files for each area and links to the official docs.

**Try asking:**
- "Add subscriptions with a free trial using Stripe"
- "Should I use Checkout or the Payment Element for my store?"
- "Set up Stripe Connect for a marketplace"
